unresolved.why: The 1998 creations took districts from several governorates (sources disagree which), so pre-1998 parents are not unions of NE atoms; Socotra (inside NE Hadramawt) belonged to Aden; Saudi border undefined east of the Taif line until 2000. Not attempted.

unresolved.what: Aden and Hadramawt while the Socotra transfer date is uncertain
unresolved.why: Socotra moved from Aden to Hadramawt in 2004 (Wikipedia, citing Yemen Times 2013) or ~2000 (Statoids); during 2004 the archipelago may still belong to Aden.

unresolved.what: Hadramawt after Socotra governorate split; Socotra governorate itself
unresolved.why: NE has no Socotra atom; the archipelago is part of NE Hadramawt (YEM-3497, 5 parts). Hadramawt 2013+ = YEM-3497 minus its island parts, which needs splitting the multipolygon — a finer atom.
